content: Sneha Roy inquired about premium rate flexibility and questioned the reason for the premium increase despite having five years of no-claims. Karan Joshi explained the increase was due to rising construction costs and offered a 5% loyalty discount along with alternative options. Sneha asked for details on the other options and whether the policy is expired or up for renewal.
